description: Structured data from a CV or resume: name, contact details, location, links, summary, skills, languages, certifications, work experience and education, with null or empty lists where the text has nothing. Plain text, or a PDF with a text layer by URL or base64. Dates are kept as written. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

pdf_base64.description: The PDF as base64, up to 15 MB (JSON body field)

text.description: The CV text (JSON body field); or give url or pdf_base64 instead

url.description: https link to a PDF CV with a text layer (JSON body field)

name: resume_parse
title: Resume Parse
